# KAIST Pure Research Portal

> KAIST's research output and innovation showcase featuring peer-reviewed publications, emerging technologies, and academic collaboration across science and engineering disciplines.

Pure is KAIST's research information system that aggregates and disseminates research outputs from Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, one of Asia's leading science and technology universities. The portal indexes publications, innovations, and research collaborations indexed in Scopus and other academic databases.

## Research Portal & Overview

- [Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr): KAIST research portal showcasing innovation, research output, and academic collaboration

## Engineering & Robotics Research

- [Mechatronic considerations for actuation of human assistive wearable robotics: Robust control of a series elastic actuator](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/mechatronic-considerations-for-actuation-of-human-assistive-weara): Kong et al. research on wearable robotics and human-robot interaction control
- [Demonstration of ElaStick: A Variable Stiffness Display for Rendering Handheld Flexible Object](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/demonstration-of-elastick-a-variable-stiffness-display-for-render): Ryu et al. research on ElaStick haptic feedback technology for VR applications
- [Multi-modal vibration control using adaptive positive position feedback](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/multi-modal-vibration-control-using-adaptive-positive-position-fe): Rew et al. research on vibration control and piezoelectric actuation systems

## Materials Science & Photonics

- [Electrically benign dry-etching method for rutile TiO>2> thin-film capacitors with Ru electrodes](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/electrically-benign-dry-etching-method-for-rutile-tiosub2sub-thin): Kim et al. research on dry-etching for TiO2 thin-film capacitors and material science
- [Sub-150 fs pulses from a Tm: KLuW oscillator in the 2 μm wavelength range](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/sub-150-fs-pulses-from-a-tm-kluw-oscillator-in-the-2-μm-wavelengt): Schmidt et al. research on femtosecond laser pulses in infrared wavelength range
- [Numerical formula of depinning fields from notches in ferromagnetic permalloy nanowire](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/numerical-formula-of-depinning-fields-from-notches-in-ferromagnet): Kim et al. research on ferromagnetic nanowire properties and magnetic materials
- [FEM simulation of warpage orientation change of FRP polymer substrate during thermal processing](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/fem-simulation-of-warpage-orientation-change-of-frp-polymer-subst): Kim et al. research on FRP substrate simulation and semiconductor packaging

## Computer Vision & Machine Learning

- [Towards high-performance object detection: Task-specific design considering classification and localization separation](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/towards-high-performance-object-detection-task-specific-design-co): Kim et al. research on deep learning and computer vision for object detection
- [Fast affine-invariant image matching based on global Bhattacharyya measure with adaptive tree](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/fast-affine-invariant-image-matching-based-on-global-bhattacharyy): Son et al. research on computer vision image matching and feature correspondence

## Biotechnology & IoT Systems

- [Characterization of humanized antibody produced by apoptosis-resistant CHO cells under sodium butyrate-induced condition](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/characterization-of-humanized-antibody-produced-by-apoptosis-resi): Kim et al. research on antibody production and recombinant protein characterization
- [Internet of Things platform and services for connected cars](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/internet-of-things-platform-and-services-for-connected-cars): Woo et al. research on IoT platforms and connected vehicle services

## Technology & Innovation Studies

- [Recombination sources and breakthrough inventions: university-developed technology versus firm-developed technology](https://pure.kaist.ac.kr/en/publications/recombination-sources-and-breakthrough-inventions-university-deve): Hyun Ju Jung's research on technology recombination and breakthrough invention processes
